    23    and scale parameter `γ` (when `γ ≠ 0`).
    24  * `cauchyPDF`: `ℝ≥0∞`-valued pdf, `cauchyPDF μ v x = ENNReal.ofReal (cauchyPDFReal μ v x)`.
